parameters.name: InstanceId
parameters.description:
The bastion host ID.

> You can call the [DescribeInstances](~~153281~~) operation to query the bastion host ID.

parameters.name: RegionId
parameters.description:
The region ID of the bastion host.

> For more information about the mapping between region IDs and region names, see [Regions and zones](~~40654~~).

parameters.name: UserGroupId
parameters.description:
The ID of the user group from which you want to revoke permissions on databases and database accounts.

> You can call the [ListUserGroups](~~204509~~) operation to query the ID of the user group.

example.unifiedCli: aliyun yundun-bastionhost detach-database-accounts-from-user-group --instance-id bastionhost-cn-7mz2v120f0y --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --user-group-id 1 --databases '[{"DatabaseId":"4","DatabaseAccountIds":["1"]}]' --region cn-hangzhou
